_comment: Identity, policies and fixed texts. Placeholders {{owner}}, {{them}} (object pronoun), {{assistant}} and {{email}} are filled from this file when the code loads. Edit the values below for your own deployment; keep personal knowledge in your private knowledge base (see docs/knowledge-base.md), not here.

policies._comment: Opt-in behaviours. All false by default.

fixed_text.welcome: Hello! I'm {{assistant}}, {{owner}}'s AI assistant. How can I help you today?
fixed_text.financial_refusal: {{owner}} has asked me not to disclose personal financial details.
fixed_text.unknown_detail: That detail hasn’t been provided by {{owner}}.
fixed_text.authored_messaging_unavailable: I can't save or pass on messages at the moment, so I don't want to promise that. You can reach {{owner}} directly at {{email}}.
fixed_text.authored_source_withheld: That detail is withheld from {{owner}}'s public profile, so I can't confirm or name it. For further inquiry, you can email {{them}} at {{email}}.
fixed_text.authored_error_fallback: I'm having trouble answering that right now. You're welcome to contact {{owner}} directly at {{email}}.
fixed_text.authored_input_too_long: That message is a bit long for me to handle. Could you shorten it to the key question?
fixed_text.authored_farewell: Thank you for your time, and do reach out to {{owner}} directly if anything else comes up.
fixed_text.unknown_detail_with_inquiry: That detail hasn’t been provided by {{owner}}. Would you like to leave an inquiry for {{them}}?
fixed_text.authored_unknown_no_messaging: Currently, I don’t have information on that. You can contact {{owner}} at {{email}} for clarification.
fixed_text.authored_message_request_no_messaging: I can't forward messages or inquiries yet. You can email {{owner}} directly at {{email}}.
fixed_text.authored_source_contact: For further inquiry, you can email {{owner}} at {{email}}.
fixed_text.authored_source_withheld_sentence: That detail is withheld from {{owner}}'s public profile, so I can't confirm or name it.
fixed_text.authored_source_withheld_with_inquiry: That detail is withheld from {{owner}}'s public profile, so I can't confirm or name it. Would you like to leave an inquiry for {{them}}?
fixed_text.authored_authorship_answer: {{owner}} led the analysis and the major decisions, and directed the AI coding assistance that handled the implementation, rather than writing every line personally.
fixed_text.authored_authorship_brand: {{owner}} led the analysis and the major decisions, and directed the AI coding assistance that handled the implementation. The specific tool isn't named in the approved profile, so I can't confirm or rule out any particular one.
fixed_text.authored_claims_fallback: I can only share what {{owner}}'s profile records, and it doesn't record more than that on this point. Is there another part of their work you'd like me to cover?
fixed_text.authored_intro_ack: Thank you for introducing yourself. How can I help you today?
fixed_text.authored_contact_no_messaging: You can contact {{owner}} at {{email}} for clarification.
fixed_text.authored_contact_with_messaging: Would you like to leave an inquiry for {{owner}}?
fixed_text.scope_refusal: That is outside my scope, as instructed by {{owner}}.
fixed_text.unknown_detail_no_messaging: Currently, I don’t have information on that. You can contact {{owner}} at {{email}} for clarification.
fixed_text.unknown_finance_detail: Currently, I don’t have information on that. It would be best to discuss this directly with {{owner}} at {{email}}.
fixed_text.authored_contact_no_messaging_named: You can contact {{them}} at {{email}} for clarification.
fixed_text.authored_contact_with_messaging_named: Would you like to leave an inquiry for {{them}}?
